title: OpenBao database secrets
description: OpenBao database secrets. Native SPL operator-question bindings. Read panel descriptions for windows, missing data, and required external sources. Native alert parity is not mapped. See the profile validation record for tested environments.

options.query:
`openbao_audit_events`
| search request_id=$request_id|s$ request_path=$request_path|s$ logical_namespace=$logical_namespace|s$ operation=$operation|s$ host=$host|s$
| search request_path=$mount_path|s$
| where audit_type="request" AND match(request_path,"^.+/(config|roles|creds|static-roles|static-creds|rotate-root|rotate-role)(/|$)")
| stats count AS value

`openbao_audit_events`
| search request_id=$request_id|s$ request_path=$request_path|s$ logical_namespace=$logical_namespace|s$ operation=$operation|s$ host=$host|s$
| search request_path=$mount_path|s$
| where audit_type="request" AND match(request_path,"^.+/(config|roles|creds|static-roles|static-creds|rotate-root|rotate-role)(/|$)")
| timechart span=5m count BY host limit=10 useother=t

`openbao_audit_events`
| search request_id=$request_id|s$ request_path=$request_path|s$ logical_namespace=$logical_namespace|s$ operation=$operation|s$ host=$host|s$
| search request_path=$mount_path|s$
| where audit_type="request" AND match(request_path,"^.+/(config|roles|static-roles|rotate-root|rotate-role)(/|$)")
| stats count AS value

`openbao_audit_events`
| search request_id=$request_id|s$ request_path=$request_path|s$ logical_namespace=$logical_namespace|s$ operation=$operation|s$ host=$host|s$
| search request_path=$mount_path|s$
| where audit_type="request" AND match(request_path,"^.+/(config|roles|static-roles|rotate-root|rotate-role)(/|$)")
| sort 100 - _time
| table _time host audit_type request_id logical_namespace request_path operation caller client_ip audit_error

| `openbao_metric_samples("vault_database_NewUser_count")`
| search cluster=$cluster|s$ instance=$instance|s$ scrape_profile=$scrape_profile|s$ kubernetes_namespace=$kubernetes_namespace|s$ openbao_namespace=$openbao_namespace|s$
| where metric_name="vault_database_NewUser_count"
| eval series=case(metric_name="vault_database_NewUser_count","database_NewUser") ." | ".coalesce(openbao_namespace,"(missing)") ." | ".cluster ." | ".scrape_profile
| `openbao_metric_rate5m`
| stats sum(value) AS value BY bucket_time cluster scrape_profile series
| eval _time=bucket_time
| `openbao_metric_fresh`
| stats latest(value) AS value BY cluster scrape_profile series
| stats sum(value) AS value count AS contributing_series
| where contributing_series>0
| fields - contributing_series
